title: 第25章 百年结算惊天奖励第26章 你是男人嘛鏖战九凤
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
这让李玄霄感到遗憾的事情，便是那本《九转大巫诀》，自己修炼不了。
按道理来说，李玄霄已然炼化了后天祖巫精血，算是半个巫族也不过分，可李玄霄尝试修炼此功法之时，却倍感阻力。
一番探究之后，李玄霄找到了原因。
元神！
是的，李玄霄乃是人族出身，是有元神的。
正常修士在境界到达一定程度后，魂魄会强化凝实炼出元神来，自身真灵寄托于元神，元神再寄托于肉身，有了元神便能修仙。
但巫族不同，巫族修为再高，也不会有元神，他们的真灵直接寄托在强悍的肉身之上，故他们不能修行，可也正因为没有了元神，他们能更容易的参悟法则之力。
李玄霄有了元神便可修仙，但却不能修这《九转大巫诀》。
《九转大巫诀》乃巫族重要功法，若是寻常巫族得了祖巫精血，再修炼这《九转大巫诀》，过不了多久便可神功九转大成，成为大巫级别的存在，可比肩、甚至小胜大罗金仙。
但李玄霄却因为这元神，无法修炼这《九转大巫诀》。
“不过这也不算什么太大的问题，虽然眼下我肉身力量强悍，但说到底，我不是体修，我之主修也不是锻体。”
李玄霄微微摇头。
只是自己毕竟炼化了祖巫精血，在炼体一道，的确很有天资。
“若有机会，日后可修一修那《八九玄功》！”
李玄霄突然想到了这本号称能够直入混元的玄门护教功法。
似乎其更在《九转大巫诀》之上？
日后若有机会，当谋求一番。
既然这《九转大巫诀》修炼不了，李玄霄只以《上清仙法-锻体篇》内容梳理了一下自身气血，之后便也不准备再逗留于此，只是在要起身的时候，发现不知何时，那面古镜在微微发出华光。
“是啊，此番闭关倒是大几十年过去了，该是新一轮的百年结算了。”
李玄霄自言道。

虽然李玄霄知晓这过去的百年也算参与了一件大事，自己结算的评级应该很高，奖励的机缘应该也是不俗的，可等真的看到了这奖励的机缘，李玄霄也是不由得震惊了一瞬！
【百年结算开始！】
【结算事件一：改命九凤！蓬莱仙岛，坊市初遇，结缘大巫九凤，为救九凤身入量劫、陷入危局，疾驰十万大山，寻得祖巫帝江，终救九凤。评级：仙品上！】
【得机缘：先天异宝-替身木偶。替身木偶，分属阴阳，有惊天奇异之能，可避致死一击，逆天改命。】
【结算事件二：凝练精血！洪荒茫茫，祖巫十二，得后土祖巫精血，更炼力之法则，肉身堪比太乙！评级：仙品上！】
【得机缘：先天灵宝-青霄道葫。混沌二分，东海之畔先天风雷灵脉深处，一缕先天巽风本源、一道先天雷霆道则孕育一尊宝葫芦。】
【结算事件三：瑞兽白泽！东海之上，偶遇白泽，结善缘，当有善果。评级：仙品下！】
【得机缘：先天灵材-雷池精粹。雷池之精，蕴恐怖雷霆之力，炼化可感雷霆之力，可得先天雷灵之体。】
【百年结算完成，待领取机缘：先天异宝-替身木偶、先天灵宝-青霄道葫、先天灵材-雷池精粹。】
李玄霄还是第一次见到先天异宝，当即便是将那替身木偶取出。
这替身木偶与李玄霄面容有七分类似，分阴、阳两只。
这替身木偶的使用方法倒也简单，阴木偶携带于身，阳木偶则存于一处安全处。
当李玄霄遇到致命伤害时，阴木偶会替他身死，同时将他苏生至阳木偶所在之处，苏生之后，当为新一世，逆天改命，不受此前因果束缚。
content_en:
The thing that made Li Xuanxiao regretful was that he couldn't practice the "Nine Revolutions of Great Witchcraft".
Logically speaking, Li Xuanxiao had already refined the acquired ancestral witch essence and blood, and he could be considered half of the witch clan. However, when Li Xuanxiao tried to practice this technique, he felt a lot of resistance.
After some research, Li Xuanxiao found the reason.
Yuanshen!
Yes, Li Xuanxiao is from the human race and has a soul.
After a normal monk reaches a certain level, his soul will be strengthened and condensed to refine the soul. His true spirit will be placed in the soul, and the soul will be placed in the physical body. With the soul, he can cultivate immortality.
But the Wu Clan is different. No matter how high the Wu Clan's cultivation is, they will not have a soul. Their true spirit is directly placed on the powerful body, so they cannot practice. But precisely because they don't have a soul, they can comprehend the power of the law more easily.
Li Xuanxiao can cultivate immortality with his soul, but he cannot cultivate the "Nine Revolutions of Great Witchcraft".
The "Nine Transformations of the Great Witch Technique" is an important skill of the witch clan. If an ordinary witch clan obtains the essence and blood of the ancestral witch, and then practices the "Nine Transformations of the Great Witch Technique", it will not take long for him to complete the nine transformations of the magical skills and become a great witch level being, comparable to or even slightly better than the Great Luo Jinxian.
But Li Xuanxiao was unable to practice the "Nine Revolutions of Great Witchcraft" because of this soul.
"But this is not a big problem. Although my physical strength is strong at the moment, in the final analysis, I am not a physical practitioner, and my main practice is not body training."
Li Xuanxiao shook his head slightly.
It's just that after all, he has refined the essence and blood of the ancestral witch, and he is indeed very talented in body refining.
"If you have the chance, you can practice the "Eight-Nine Mysterious Techniques" in the future!"
Li Xuanxiao suddenly thought of this Taoist teaching method that claimed to be able to penetrate directly into Hunyuan.
It seems that it is better than "Nine Revolutions of Great Witchcraft"?
If there is an opportunity in the future, I should look for it.
Since he couldn't practice the "Nine Revolutions of Great Witchcraft", Li Xuanxiao only sorted out his energy and blood based on the contents of "Shangqing Immortal Technique - Body Training", and then he was not ready to stay here anymore. But when he was about to get up, he found that the ancient mirror was glowing slightly.
"Yes, decades have passed since this retreat. It's time for a new round of centenary settlement."
Li Xuanxiao said to himself.
Although Li Xuanxiao knew that he had participated in a major event in the past hundred years, his settlement rating should be very high, and the opportunity for reward should be good, but when he actually saw the opportunity for reward, Li Xuanxiao couldn't help but be shocked for a moment!
[The centenary settlement begins! 】
[Settlement Event 1: Change your life to Nine Phoenix! Penglai Fairy Island, Fang Shi met him for the first time, and became acquainted with the great witch Jiu Feng. In order to save Jiu Feng, he suffered a lot of calamity and fell into a crisis. He galloped across a hundred thousand mountains, found the ancestral witch emperor river, and finally saved Jiu Feng. Rating: Excellent! 】
[Opportunity: Innate rare treasure - stand-in puppet. The stand-in puppet belongs to yin and yang, and has amazing and miraculous abilities. It can avoid fatal blows and change fate against the will of heaven. 】
[Settlement Event 2: Condensing Essence and Blood! In the vast wilderness, the twelve ancestral witches received the essence and blood of the Tu ancestral witch, and further refined the rules of strength, and their physical bodies were comparable to Taiyi! Rating: Excellent! 】
[Get the opportunity: Innate Spiritual Treasure-Qingxiao Dao Gourd. Chaos is divided into two parts. Deep in the innate wind and thunder spirit veins on the bank of the East China Sea, a wisp of the origin of the innate Sunda wind and an innate thunder path give birth to a treasure gourd. 】
[Settlement event three: The auspicious beast Bai Ze! On the East China Sea, if you meet Bai Ze by chance and form a good relationship, there should be good results. Rating: Excellent! 】
[Opportunity: Innate spiritual material - the essence of thunder pool. The essence of the thunder pool contains the power of terrifying thunder. When refined, the power of thunder can be felt, and the body of the innate thunder spirit can be obtained. 】
[The centenary settlement has been completed, and the opportunity to receive it is waiting for: the innate rare treasure - stand-in puppet, the innate spiritual treasure - Qingxiao Dao Gourd, the innate spiritual material - the essence of Lei Chi. 】
This was the first time Li Xuanxiao saw an innate treasure, and he took out the puppet puppet.
This stand-in puppet has a similar face to Li Xuanxiao, divided into two parts: yin and yang.
The method of using this stand-in puppet is quite simple, YinmuThe puppet is carried with the body, while the yang puppet is stored in a safe place.
When Li Xuanxiao encounters fatal injuries, the Yin puppet will die for him, and at the same time he will be resurrected to the place where the Yang puppet is. After resurrecting, he will be a new life, changing his fate against the will of heaven, and not being bound by the previous cause and effect.
